MISSION VIEJO CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING SUMMARY
  May 22, 2018

NOTE: This Summary is for informational purposes only and is not a record of the official action taken by
the Mission Viejo City Council. Approved City Council Meeting Minutes constitute the only record of
official City Council action. The minutes of this meeting will be available after they are approved by the
City Council at its next regularly scheduled meeting.

CALL TO ORDER — City Council, Community Development Financing Authority, Housing Authority, Library
Board of Trustees, and Successor Agency of the Community Development Agency.

Called to order at 5:00 p.m.

INVOCATION: Council Member Bucknum

FLAG CEREMONY AND PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Boy Scout Troop 603

PRESENTATIONS

  P1.  Proclaim May through October, 2018, as "Drowning Prevention and Awareness"
  Months

  The Council presented the proclamation to Fire Chief Capobianco.

CONSENT CALENDAR

 B/K Approved the Consent Calendar as outlined.

  1.  City Council Minutes

  Approved the Minutes for the regular City Council meeting of May 8, 2018, as presented.

  2.  Check Register Dated May 4, 2018 in the Amount of $1,962,731.83

  Ratified the accompanying check register.

  3.  Quarterly Financial Report for the City of Mission Viejo - Third Quarter 2017-18

  Received and filed.

  4.  Transmittal of Pre-PARE Trustee Reports for the period October 1, 2017 through
  March 31, 2018

  Received and filed the accompanying Pre-PARE Trustee Reports for the Quarter ending
  October 1, 2017 through March 31, 2018.

City Council Summary  1  May 22, 2018
   5.  Olympiad Road/Felipe Road Corridor Traffic Signal Synchronization Project (CIP
  18236)

  Approved the plans and specifications and authorized staff to advertise for bids for the
  Olympiad Road/Felipe Road Traffic Signal Synchronization Project (CIP 18236).

 ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR

 OLD BUSINESS

  6.  Insurance Pool Membership for City General Liability and Worker's Compensation
  Insurance Coverage

 R/K  Approved staff’s recommendation to continue as a member of the California Joint Powers
  Insurance Authority (CJPIA) and authorization to notify CJPIA to continue membership.

 MAYOR’S, COMMISSION, COMMITTEE REPORTS AND ACTIONS

  7.  Transportation Corridor Agency Report

  Mayor Sachs presented the report.

 STAFF REPORTS

  8.  Orange County Fire Authority (OCFA) Update from Chief Capobianco

  Chief Capobianco presented the report.

COUNCIL MEMBER COMMENTS AND ACTIONS

  9.  Council Member Reports of Events and Activities Attended

  By consensus, the City Council Members acknowledged their event and activities calendars as
  presented in the report and agreed to provide any changes to the City Clerk for the public record.

 Council Member Bucknum

 Council Member Goodell

 Council Member Kelley

 Mayor Pro Tem Raths

 Mayor Sachs

ADJOURNMENT AT 7:35 P.M. TO TUESDAY, JUNE 12, 2018, AT 5:00 P.M.

City Council Summary  2  May 22, 2018
